slides.headline: A kid who wanted to build things
slides.sub: (websites, marketing, big ideas. too many strings to pull.)

slides.kicker: For years I hit the same wall
slides.headline: No team. No time. No clue.
slides.sub: olive oil taught me margins. coaching taught me my time was the limit.

slides.headline: One agent builds. You orchestrate.
slides.sub: a small swarm does the making. you do the deciding.

slides.headline: You are in control
slides.sub: the kid who couldn't build now runs the whole show.
